identity.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust Tokenized bStocks

about.description: SPYB is a tokenized certificate issued by BTECH Holdings Limited (ADGM) that provides economic exposure to SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust. SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance of the S&P 500 index, which measures the performance of 500 large-cap U.S. companies. Each token is backed 1 to 1 by a corresponding ETF unit held in a segregated custody account with a regulated custodian under ADGM FSRA Ledger-Based Securities rules. SPYB is admitted to the ADGM Official List of Securities. Convertibility to real units is available via the Binance-affiliated broker-dealer Nest Trading Limited, and distribution value is delivered through an on-chain Multiplier rebasing mechanism at the bStocks framework level. Aggregate proof of collateral is published on the Binance Proof of Collateral dashboard covering the entire bStocks family. Access is restricted from United States persons.
